// DASH-006 — Top Network Targets by TCP Latency
// Source: SPL-D006-0083
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let UserFilter = tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter = tostring(_host);
let TargetFilter = tostring(_target);
Process_NetworkTargetPerformance
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| where NetTargetProtocols =~ "TCP"
| extend Target = iff(isnotempty(NetTargetRemoteName), NetTargetRemoteName, tostring(NetTargetRemoteAddress))
| where isempty(UserFilter) or tolower(ProcUser) =~ UserFilter
| where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
| where isempty(TargetFilter) or Target =~ TargetFilter
| where isnotempty(Target)
| summarize
    LatencyTotalMs = sum(NetTargetSendLatencyMs),
    LatencySamples = sum(NetTargetSendLatencyCount),
    InitialLatencyTotalMs = sum(NetTargetSendLatencyInitialMs),
    InitialLatencySamples = sum(NetTargetSendLatencyInitialCount),
    Hosts = dcount(Host),
    Processes = dcount(ProcName),
    Users = dcount(ProcUser)
    by Target, TargetPort = NetTargetRemotePort
| extend
    AvgTCPSendLatencyMs = iff(LatencySamples > 0, round(LatencyTotalMs / LatencySamples, 1), real(null)),
    AvgInitialTCPSendLatencyMs = iff(InitialLatencySamples > 0, round(InitialLatencyTotalMs / InitialLatencySamples, 1), real(null))
| top 20 by AvgTCPSendLatencyMs desc
| project Target, TargetPort, AvgTCPSendLatencyMs, AvgInitialTCPSendLatencyMs, Hosts, Processes, Users, LatencySamples

// DASH-006 — Top Citrix Sessions by ICA Latency
// Source: SPL-D006-0117
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let UserFilter = tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter = tostring(_host);
let SessionFilter = tostring(_session);
Session_SessionDetail
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| where SessionProtocol =~ "ICA"
| where isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID))
| where isempty(UserFilter) or tolower(SessionUser) =~ UserFilter
| where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
| where isempty(SessionFilter) or tostring(SessionGUID) == SessionFilter
| summarize
    AvgICALatencyMs = round(avg(SessionRpLatencyMs2), 1),
    AvgICARoundTripTimeMs = round(avg(toreal(SessionRoundTripTimeMs)), 1),
    User = take_any(SessionUser),
    Host = take_any(Host),
    LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
    by SessionGUID
| extend UserName = extract(@"([^\\]+)$", 1, User)
| extend UserAtHost = strcat(UserName, "@", Host)
| top 20 by AvgICALatencyMs desc
| project UserAtHost, SessionGUID, AvgICALatencyMs, AvgICARoundTripTimeMs, LastSeen

// DASH-006 — TCP Latency and Jitter Over Time
// Source: SPL-D006-0084
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let UserFilter = tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter = tostring(_host);
let TargetFilter = tostring(_target);
let TimeBin = 15m;
Process_NetworkTargetPerformance
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| extend Target = iff(isnotempty(NetTargetRemoteName), NetTargetRemoteName, tostring(NetTargetRemoteAddress))
| where isempty(UserFilter) or tolower(ProcUser) =~ UserFilter
| where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
| where isempty(TargetFilter) or Target =~ TargetFilter
| where NetTargetProtocols =~ "TCP"
| summarize
    InitialLatencyTotalMs = sum(NetTargetSendLatencyInitialMs),
    InitialLatencySamples = sum(NetTargetSendLatencyInitialCount),
    LatencyTotalMs = sum(NetTargetSendLatencyMs),
    LatencySamples = sum(NetTargetSendLatencyCount),
    JitterTotalMs = sum(NetTargetSendJitterMs),
    JitterSamples = sum(NetTargetSendJitterCount)
    by TimeBucket = bin(Timestamp, TimeBin)
| extend
    AvgInitialTCPSendLatencyMs = iff(InitialLatencySamples > 0, round(InitialLatencyTotalMs / InitialLatencySamples, 1), real(null)),
    AvgTCPSendLatencyMs = iff(LatencySamples > 0, round(LatencyTotalMs / LatencySamples, 1), real(null)),
    AvgTCPSendJitterMs = iff(JitterSamples > 0, round(JitterTotalMs / JitterSamples, 1), real(null))
| project TimeBucket, AvgInitialTCPSendLatencyMs, AvgTCPSendLatencyMs, AvgTCPSendJitterMs
| order by TimeBucket asc

// DASH-006 — Network Target TCP Latency Over Time
// Source: SPL-D006-0087
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let UserFilter = tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter = tostring(_host);
let TargetFilter = tostring(_target);
let TimeBin = 15m;
let TopTargets =
    Process_NetworkTargetPerformance
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where NetTargetProtocols =~ "TCP"
    | extend Target = iff(isnotempty(NetTargetRemoteName), NetTargetRemoteName, tostring(NetTargetRemoteAddress))
    | where isempty(UserFilter) or tolower(ProcUser) =~ UserFilter
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
    | where isempty(TargetFilter) or Target =~ TargetFilter
    | where isnotempty(Target)
    | summarize Samples=sum(NetTargetSendLatencyCount) by Target
    | top 12 by Samples desc
    | project Target;

Process_NetworkTargetPerformance
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| where NetTargetProtocols =~ "TCP"
| extend Target = iff(isnotempty(NetTargetRemoteName), NetTargetRemoteName, tostring(NetTargetRemoteAddress))
| where isempty(UserFilter) or tolower(ProcUser) =~ UserFilter
| where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
| where isempty(TargetFilter) or Target =~ TargetFilter
| where Target in (TopTargets)
| summarize
    LatencyTotalMs = sum(NetTargetSendLatencyMs),
    LatencySamples = sum(NetTargetSendLatencyCount),
    InitialLatencyTotalMs = sum(NetTargetSendLatencyInitialMs),
    InitialLatencySamples = sum(NetTargetSendLatencyInitialCount)
    by TimeBucket = bin(Timestamp, TimeBin), Target
| extend
    AvgTCPSendLatencyMs = iff(LatencySamples > 0, round(LatencyTotalMs / LatencySamples, 1), real(null)),
    AvgInitialTCPSendLatencyMs = iff(InitialLatencySamples > 0, round(InitialLatencyTotalMs / InitialLatencySamples, 1), real(null))
| project TimeBucket, Target, AvgTCPSendLatencyMs, AvgInitialTCPSendLatencyMs
| order by TimeBucket asc, Target asc

// DASH-006 — Session Network and ICA Detail
// Source: SPL-D006-0096
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let UserFilter = tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter = tostring(_host);
let SessionFilter = tostring(_session);
let LatestSession =
    Session_SessionDetail
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID))
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, SessionUser, Host, SessionID, SessionLogonTime, SessionProtocol, SessionConnectionState) by SessionGUID
    | project SessionGUID, User=SessionUser, Host, SessionID, LogonTime=SessionLogonTime, LastSeen=Timestamp, Protocol=SessionProtocol, LastState=SessionConnectionState
    | where isempty(UserFilter) or tolower(User) =~ UserFilter
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
    | where isempty(SessionFilter) or tostring(SessionGUID) == SessionFilter;
let SessionMetrics =
    Session_SessionDetail
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID))
    | where isempty(SessionFilter) or tostring(SessionGUID) == SessionFilter
    | summarize
        AvgProcesses=round(avg(toreal(SessionProcessCount)), 1),
        AvgCPUPercent=round(avg(SessionCPUUsagePercent), 1),
        AvgIOPS=round(avg(SessionIOPS), 1),
        AvgIOVolumeMB=round(avg(SessionIOMB), 2),
        AvgIOLatencyMs=round(avg(SessionIOLatencyMs), 1),
        AvgRAMMB=round(avg(SessionWorkingSetMB), 0),
        AvgNetworkKBPS=round(avg(SessionNetKBPS), 1),
        AvgICALatencyMs=round(avg(SessionRpLatencyMs2), 1),
        AvgICARTTMs=round(avg(toreal(SessionRoundTripTimeMs)), 1)
        by SessionGUID;
let SessionEnd =
    Logoff_LogoffDetail
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID))
    | where isempty(SessionFilter) or tostring(SessionGUID) == SessionFilter
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, SessionEndTime) by SessionGUID
    | project SessionGUID, SessionEnd=SessionEndTime;
LatestSession
| join kind=leftouter SessionMetrics on SessionGUID
| join kind=leftouter SessionEnd on SessionGUID
| project SessionGUID, User, Host, SessionID, LogonTime, LastSeen, SessionEnd, Protocol, LastState, AvgProcesses, AvgCPUPercent, AvgIOPS, AvgIOVolumeMB, AvgIOLatencyMs, AvgRAMMB, AvgNetworkKBPS, AvgICALatencyMs, AvgICARTTMs
| order by LastSeen desc

// DASH-006 — Application Network Issue Summary
// Source: SPL-D006-0132
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let UserFilter = tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter = tostring(_host);
let TargetFilter = tostring(_target);
let AppMap =
    Application_AppNameIdMapping
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, AppName) by Host, AppId
    | project Host, AppId, AppName;
let Failures =
    Application_NetworkConnectFailure
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | extend TargetAddress = iff(isnotempty(NetTargetRemoteName), NetTargetRemoteName, tostring(NetTargetRemoteAddress))
    | where isempty(UserFilter) or tolower(User) =~ UserFilter
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
    | where isempty(TargetFilter) or TargetAddress =~ TargetFilter
    | join kind=leftouter AppMap on Host, AppId
    | extend Application = iff(isempty(AppName), ProcessName, AppName)
    | summarize
        FailureCount = count(),
        TargetCount = dcount(TargetAddress),
        PortCount = dcount(NetTargetRemotePort),
        AppCount = dcount(Application),
        TcpFailureCount = countif(NetTargetProtocols contains "TCP");
let Performance =
    Process_NetworkTargetPerformance
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | extend Target = iff(isnotempty(NetTargetRemoteName), NetTargetRemoteName, tostring(NetTargetRemoteAddress))
    | where isempty(UserFilter) or tolower(ProcUser) =~ UserFilter
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
    | where isempty(TargetFilter) or Target =~ TargetFilter
    | summarize
        ConnectCount = sum(NetTargetConnectCount),
        ReconnectCount = sum(NetTargetReconnectCount),
        RetransmitCount = sum(NetTargetRetransmitCount),
        SendCount = sum(NetTargetSendCount),
        ReceiveCount = sum(NetTargetReceiveCount),
        JitterCount = sum(NetTargetSendJitterCount),
        JitterMs = sum(NetTargetSendJitterMs);
Failures
| extend JoinKey = 1
| join kind=inner (Performance | extend JoinKey = 1) on JoinKey
| extend
    ConnectAvailability = iff(TcpFailureCount + ConnectCount > 0, round(100.0 - (100.0 * (TcpFailureCount + ReconnectCount) / (TcpFailureCount + ConnectCount)), 3), real(null)),
    TransmitAvailability = iff(SendCount > 0, round(100.0 - (100.0 * RetransmitCount / SendCount), 3), real(null)),
    PacketLossPercent = iff(RetransmitCount + SendCount > 0, round(100.0 * RetransmitCount / (RetransmitCount + SendCount), 2), real(null)),
    AvgJitterMs = iff(JitterCount > 0, round(JitterMs / JitterCount, 1), real(null))
| extend NetworkAvailability = iff(isnotnull(ConnectAvailability) and isnotnull(TransmitAvailability), round((ConnectAvailability + TransmitAvailability) / 2.0, 2), real(null))
| extend Metrics = bag_pack(
    "Failure Count", toreal(FailureCount),
    "Target Count", toreal(TargetCount),
    "Application Count", toreal(AppCount),
    "Connect Count", toreal(ConnectCount),
    "Reconnect Count", toreal(ReconnectCount),
    "Retransmit Count", toreal(RetransmitCount),
    "Network Availability %", toreal(NetworkAvailability),
    "Packet Loss %", toreal(PacketLossPercent),
    "Avg Jitter ms", toreal(AvgJitterMs)
)
| mv-expand Metric = bag_keys(Metrics)
| extend Metric = tostring(Metric)
| extend MetricValue = toreal(Metrics[Metric])
| project Metric, MetricValue

// DASH-006 — Network Issues by Target Host
// Source: SPL-D006-0136
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let UserFilter = tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter = tostring(_host);
let TargetFilter = tostring(_target);
let FailureBase =
    Application_NetworkConnectFailure
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | extend TargetHost=iff(isnotempty(NetTargetRemoteName), NetTargetRemoteName, tostring(NetTargetRemoteAddress))
    | where isempty(UserFilter) or tolower(User) =~ UserFilter
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
    | where isempty(TargetFilter) or TargetHost =~ TargetFilter
    | project TargetHost, FailedConnects=1, SuccessfulConnects=0, Reconnects=0, Retransmits=0, Sends=0, Receives=0, Application=AppId, Process=ProcessName, NetworkUser=User, Host;
let PerformanceBase =
    Process_NetworkTargetPerformance
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | extend TargetHost=iff(isnotempty(NetTargetRemoteName), NetTargetRemoteName, tostring(NetTargetRemoteAddress))
    | where isempty(UserFilter) or tolower(ProcUser) =~ UserFilter
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
    | where isempty(TargetFilter) or TargetHost =~ TargetFilter
    | project TargetHost, FailedConnects=0, SuccessfulConnects=NetTargetConnectCount, Reconnects=NetTargetReconnectCount, Retransmits=NetTargetRetransmitCount, Sends=NetTargetSendCount, Receives=NetTargetReceiveCount, Application=AppId, Process=ProcName, NetworkUser=ProcUser, Host;
union FailureBase, PerformanceBase
| where isnotempty(TargetHost)
| summarize
    FailedConnects=sum(FailedConnects),
    SuccessfulConnects=sum(SuccessfulConnects),
    Reconnects=sum(Reconnects),
    Retransmits=sum(Retransmits),
    Sends=sum(Sends),
    Receives=sum(Receives),
    Applications=dcount(Application),
    Processes=dcount(Process),
    Users=dcount(NetworkUser),
    Hosts=dcount(Host)
    by TargetHost
| where FailedConnects > 0 or Reconnects > 0 or Retransmits > 0
| extend PacketLossPercent=iff(Retransmits + Sends > 0, round(100.0 * Retransmits / (Retransmits + Sends), 2), 0.0)
| order by FailedConnects desc, Retransmits desc
| take 100

// DASH-006 — Network Target Performance Details
// Source: SPL-D006-0086
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let UserFilter = tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter = tostring(_host);
let TargetFilter = tostring(_target);
Process_NetworkTargetPerformance
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| extend
    Target = iff(isnotempty(NetTargetRemoteName), NetTargetRemoteName, tostring(NetTargetRemoteAddress)),
    SourceIP = tostring(NetTargetSourceAddress)
| where isempty(UserFilter) or tolower(ProcUser) =~ UserFilter
| where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
| where isempty(TargetFilter) or Target =~ TargetFilter
| summarize
    Sends = sum(NetTargetSendCount),
    Receives = sum(NetTargetReceiveCount),
    Connects = sum(NetTargetConnectCount),
    Reconnects = sum(NetTargetReconnectCount),
    Retransmits = sum(NetTargetRetransmitCount),
    SendVolumeMB = round(sum(NetTargetSendMB), 2),
    ReceiveVolumeMB = round(sum(NetTargetReceiveMB), 2),
    LatencyTotalMs = sum(NetTargetSendLatencyMs),
    LatencySamples = sum(NetTargetSendLatencyCount),
    JitterTotalMs = sum(NetTargetSendJitterMs),
    JitterSamples = sum(NetTargetSendJitterCount),
    LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
    by Host, Process=ProcName, User=ProcUser, SourceIP, SourcePort=NetTargetSourcePort, Target, TargetPort=NetTargetRemotePort, Protocol=NetTargetProtocols
| extend
    AvgTCPSendLatencyMs = iff(LatencySamples > 0, round(LatencyTotalMs / LatencySamples, 1), real(null)),
    AvgTCPSendJitterMs = iff(JitterSamples > 0, round(JitterTotalMs / JitterSamples, 1), real(null)),
    PacketLossPercent = iff(Retransmits + Sends > 0, round(100.0 * Retransmits / (Retransmits + Sends), 2), real(null))
| order by PacketLossPercent desc, AvgTCPSendLatencyMs desc
| take 100

// DASH-006 — Network Endpoint Issue Details
// Source: SPL-D006-0137
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let UserFilter = tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter = tostring(_host);
let TargetFilter = tostring(_target);
let FailureBase =
    Application_NetworkConnectFailure
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | extend SourceIP=tostring(NetTargetSourceAddress), TargetHost=iff(isnotempty(NetTargetRemoteName), NetTargetRemoteName, tostring(NetTargetRemoteAddress))
    | where isempty(UserFilter) or tolower(User) =~ UserFilter
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
    | where isempty(TargetFilter) or TargetHost =~ TargetFilter
    | project SourceIP, SourcePort=NetTargetSourcePort, TargetHost, TargetPort=NetTargetRemotePort, FailedConnects=1, SuccessfulConnects=0, Reconnects=0, Retransmits=0, Sends=0, Receives=0;
let PerformanceBase =
    Process_NetworkTargetPerformance
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | extend SourceIP=tostring(NetTargetSourceAddress), TargetHost=iff(isnotempty(NetTargetRemoteName), NetTargetRemoteName, tostring(NetTargetRemoteAddress))
    | where isempty(UserFilter) or tolower(ProcUser) =~ UserFilter
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
    | where isempty(TargetFilter) or TargetHost =~ TargetFilter
    | project SourceIP, SourcePort=NetTargetSourcePort, TargetHost, TargetPort=NetTargetRemotePort, FailedConnects=0, SuccessfulConnects=NetTargetConnectCount, Reconnects=NetTargetReconnectCount, Retransmits=NetTargetRetransmitCount, Sends=NetTargetSendCount, Receives=NetTargetReceiveCount;
union FailureBase, PerformanceBase
| summarize
    SourcePorts=make_set(SourcePort,100),
    FailedConnects=sum(FailedConnects),
    SuccessfulConnects=sum(SuccessfulConnects),
    Reconnects=sum(Reconnects),
    Retransmits=sum(Retransmits),
    Sends=sum(Sends),
    Receives=sum(Receives)
    by SourceIP, TargetHost, TargetPort
| where FailedConnects > 0 or Reconnects > 0 or Retransmits > 0
| extend PacketLossPercent=iff(Retransmits + Sends > 0, round(100.0 * Retransmits / (Retransmits + Sends),2),0.0)
| order by FailedConnects desc, Retransmits desc
| take 100

// DASH-006 — HDX Channel and Network Configuration Detail
// Source: SPL-D006-0028
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let UserFilter = tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter = tostring(_host);
let SessionFilter = tostring(_session);
CitrixSession_SessionConfig
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| where isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID))
| where isempty(UserFilter) or tolower(SessionUser) =~ UserFilter
| where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
| where isempty(SessionFilter) or tostring(SessionGUID) == SessionFilter
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by SessionGUID
| project
    SessionGUID,
    User=SessionUser,
    Host,
    NetworkConnectedVia,
    NetworkEdtMtu,
    NetworkPolicyAcceptSessionReliabilityConnections,
    NetworkPolicySessionReliabilityPort,
    NetworkPolicySessionReliabilityTimeout,
    NetworkPolicyICAListenerPortNumber,
    AudioActualPriority,
    CdmActualPriority,
    GraphicsActualPriority,
    ThinwireActualPriority,
    PrinterActualPriority,
    USBActualPriority,
    D3DActualPriority,
    FramehawkActualPriority,
    DisplayMode,
    ThinwireVideoCodecType,
    ThinwireHardwareEncodeInUse,
    ThinwirePolicyFps
| order by User asc, Host asc

let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
Session_SessionDetail
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| where isnotempty(SessionUser)
| extend User = tolower(SessionUser), SessionKey = tostring(SessionGUID)
| summarize Sessions=dcount(SessionKey), Hosts=dcount(Host), LastSeen=max(Timestamp) by User
| extend Value=User, Label=strcat(User, " (", tostring(Sessions), " sessions)")
| project Value, Label
| order by Label asc

let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
Session_SessionDetail
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| where isnotempty(Host)
| summarize Sessions=dcount(SessionGUID), Users=dcountif(SessionUser,isnotempty(SessionUser)) by Host
| extend Value=Host, Label=strcat(Host, " (", tostring(Sessions), " sessions)")
| project Value, Label
| order by Label asc

let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let UserFilter = tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter = tostring(_host);
Session_SessionDetail
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| where isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID))
| extend User=tolower(SessionUser), SessionKey=tostring(SessionGUID)
| where isempty(UserFilter) or User =~ UserFilter
| where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, User, Host, SessionID) by SessionKey
| extend Value=SessionKey, Label=strcat(User, " @ ", Host, " | Session ", tostring(SessionID))

let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let UserFilter = tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter = tostring(_host);
Process_NetworkTargetPerformance
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| extend User=tolower(ProcUser), Target=iff(isnotempty(NetTargetRemoteName),NetTargetRemoteName,tostring(NetTargetRemoteAddress))
| where isnotempty(Target)
| where isempty(UserFilter) or User =~ UserFilter
| where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
| summarize Events=count(), Hosts=dcount(Host), Users=dcountif(User,isnotempty(User)) by Target
| extend Value=Target, Label=strcat(Target, " (", tostring(Events), " samples)")
| project Value, Label
| order by Label asc
